title: Integer Sequences which Are Closed with Respect to Multiplication and whose Sumset does not Intersect the Sequence
summary: We investigate increasing sequences of integers with the property that the product of every two terms of the sequence is also a term of the sequence and the sum of every two terms is not a term of the sequence. We say that a sequence with the above properties is maximal if it is not a proper subsequence of another sequence with the above properties. We determine whether the sequences in three families are maximal or not.
